title: Did they share a time?
hook: The Mesozoic contains several successive periods.

knows: Geological periods can be ordered in time.
doesNotKnow: Place two dinosaur examples in different Mesozoic periods.

misconception: All non-avian dinosaurs lived during one geological period.
objective: Place two dinosaur examples in different Mesozoic periods.

claims.text: The Mesozoic contains several successive periods. Stegosaurus is represented in the Late Jurassic and Triceratops in the Late Cretaceous. Are those the same geological period? The schematic shows Stegosaurus in the Jurassic and Triceratops in the later Cretaceous. Those are different geological periods. The equal-width blocks are not to scale and do not represent exact species ranges.
